findings.body:
**Reject a `--case` that does not match the phase.**

`partial-activation-service-restart --case restore-service-reboot` passes parsing and runs the restore interruption. The driver writes the result under the activation phase name and leaves the restore directory nonempty, so the correctly named restore phase cannot run afterward. Derive the expected case from the phase and reject a conflicting `--case` before running either handler.





Also applies to: 879-879
findings.title: Reject a `--case` that does not match the phase.

findings.body:
**Compare completion logs across recovery attempts.**

The first check compares the CLI baseline with a snapshot taken after that same recovery. If recovery replaces an existing entry before taking its baseline, both observations can agree on the rewritten log. The repeat check compares only counts, so it can also accept a replacement. Require the pre-recovery log to remain a prefix of the first settled log. Then require the full log to remain unchanged across the repeat. This still permits legitimate completions before the first fence settles.






Also applies to: 648-650, 711-716, 730-732
findings.title: Compare completion logs across recovery attempts.

findings.body:
**Keep labeled boundary reports available to observation.**

A boundary run with `--label run1` writes `run1.json`. The matching observation still reads the canonical `partial-<case>.json` and fails before recovery on a fresh fixture. Keep the canonical boundary artifact when a label is supplied, or let the observation select an explicit, validated boundary artifact.
findings.title: Keep labeled boundary reports available to observation.

findings.body:
**Return exit code 2 when a case phase omits `--case`.**

The missing required argument raises inside the runtime handler, which returns exit code 1. Validate the conditional argument before dispatch so callers can distinguish invalid input from a failed proof. As per coding guidelines, “Exit codes: 0 clean, 1 thrown error, 2 arg error, 3 needs-human.”






Also applies to: 878-878
findings.title: Return exit code 2 when a case phase omits `--case`.

findings.body:
**Verify that the interruption preserves existing completion entries.**

If the drained log contains one Python completion and the interrupted restore removes it, Line 566 slices the empty log at index 1. Line 572 accepts the empty suffix as evidence that no work ran. The activation boundary also ignores changes within the old prefix. In both cases, compare the old log with the corresponding prefix of the new log before checking the suffix.






Also applies to: 566-566
findings.title: Verify that the interruption preserves existing completion entries.
